role: Regional planning agency / transit grant recipient
stance_basis: mentioned as grant recipient supporting transit improvements related to the project area, no explicit position stated
summary: The Richmond Regional Planning District Commission (RRPDC) is mentioned in the document solely in the context of having received an Urban Mass Transportation grant to design a transit development program intended to upgrade existing bus service in the Randolph area. No explicit position for or against the Randolph Urban Renewal Project is attributed to the RRPDC; it is referenced as a supporting agency whose transit study recommendations are expected to be implemented in the mid-1970s.
complaint_summary: The RRPDC is noted as having received an Urban Mass Transportation grant to design a transit development program that will upgrade existing bus service in the Randolph area, with recommendations expected to be implemented in the mid-1970s.
summary_quote: The RRPDC approved the Randolph Plan at that meeting and congratulated members of the RPSB and the Randolph community for their participation in the planning effort.
